oliver: Quick heads up 1:30 UTC change window. small runtime patch rc-2026-04A + router 3.5.2 pin needed for routing-heuristics fix. rhea: What's the rollback plan and thresholds? tom: Propose p95 > 180ms for 2m OR 5xx > 0.5% -> rollback. Also watch session-affinity drift. mai: Staging smoke looked fine: session-reshuffle 0.05%, p95 +8ms. logs: ```INFO routing: heuristics-stable
INFO kv: header-accept ok``` deploy-bot: scheduled by @oliver at 2026-04-07T21:30:00Z ops-bot: quiet window 21:15-22:00 UTC oliver: Canary plan: 5% -> 30% -> 100%. pin router=3.5.2 until +1h. rhea: Add Dedicated exclusion for apac if kernels pinned. tom: Commands for oncall:
```
# pin
deploy-bot pin service=router version=3.5.2 --until=+1h --by=@oliver
# start canary
deploy-bot route service=router percent=5 monitor=5m
# rollback
deploy-bot rollback service=router to-version=3.5.1 --urgent
``` mai: I'll run smoke after each step and post results. ops-bot: dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/canary/1781239001 oliver: Putting release notes draft here: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-04-07-router-3.5.2 rhea: Oncall is @tom, please make sure alerting channel set to /urgent-deploys tom: set. Starting 5% canary now. deploy-bot: canary 5% initiated by @oliver at 2026-04-07T21:30:00Z mai: 5m smoke: no red flags, session-reshuffle 0.03%. move to 30%. rhea: Hold 10m at 30% then full if stable. tom: Dedicated apac excluded successfully. oliver: Moving to 100% after hold. deploy-bot: full shift executed at 2026-04-07T21:45:00Z mai: final smoke green. Removing pin scheduled +1h unless issues. oliver: Thanks all, post-release note updated and will unpin if stable. :)
